script_package.title: Pipe Wars: Roadman Rumble
script_package.description: Two roadmen, one pipe. Watch the ultimate brainrot battle for supremacy and the last puff! Who gets the pipe, bruv?
script_package.call_to_action: Tap to see who wins the pipe!
script_package.spoken_script:
Character A: "Yo, fam, what's that you're clutching, bruv? That's my pipe, innit?"
Character B: "Nah, on my life, this ain't yours. I just copped it, moving mad if you think otherwise."
Character A: "Moving mad? You're the one moving mad, fam! Hand it over before I get vexed, yeah?"
Character B: "Vexed? Try me, bruv. I'll buss your head open, on my mother's life. This pipe is mine."
Character A: "You think you're hard, eh? I'll show you hard, you washed-up starfish!"
Character B: "Starfish? You're a sponge, fam! A yellow, square sponge! You ain't finessing this from me."
Character A: "Finessing? I'm taking what's mine, you hear me? One-on-one, right now, for the pipe!"
Character B: "Alright, bet! You want smoke? You got it! Let's settle this, right here, right now!"
